description: This file is a Markdown document providing guidance and example code for API testing using Playwright in C#, specifically focusing on testing GitHub's API via APIRequestContext. It contains multiple code snippets, explanations, and test case structures related to API testing, server state setup and validation, and authentication management.

classes.name: TestGitHubAPI
classes.description: A test class demonstrating API testing for GitHub using Playwright's APIRequestContext, including setup, teardown, and individual test methods for creating issues and managing repositories.

methods.name: SetUpAPITesting
methods.description: Initializes the API request context and creates a test repository before each test.

methods.name: CreateAPIRequestContext
methods.description: Sets up the API request context with necessary headers and base URL for GitHub API.

methods.name: CreateTestRepository
methods.description: Creates a new repository on GitHub to use for testing purposes.

methods.name: TearDownAPITesting
methods.description: Deletes the test repository and disposes of the API request context after each test.

methods.name: DeleteTestRepository
methods.description: Deletes the test repository on GitHub after tests complete.

methods.name: ShouldCreateBugReport
methods.description: Test method that creates a bug issue via API and verifies its existence and details.

methods.name: ShouldCreateFeatureRequests
methods.description: Test method that creates a feature request issue via API and verifies its presence and contents.
